sources: Owner-approved twin cities gameplay, graphics and expansion roadmap, 14 November 2026
title: The Sand That Stayed
prose: The dune carries a thin stream of sand past the low wall. On this side a few old footprints have kept their edges.

choices.label: Read the sheltered tracks
choices.line: The windbreak keeps a small history while the open sand changes.

choices.label: Listen to the wind
choices.line: The wall does not stop the desert. It makes a quiet place within it.
